extraction.name: ARC (AI2 Reasoning Challenge)
extraction.description: A collection of natural, grade-school science questions designed to encourage AI research in advanced question answering. The release also includes the ARC Corpus of 14M science-related sentences and baseline neural models.
extraction.creator: Peter Clark, Isaac Cowhey, Oren Etzioni, Tushar Khot, Ashish Sabharwal, Carissa Schoenick, Oyvind Tafjord
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The ARC dataset was assembled through several months of extensive search and investigation to obtain natural science questions authored for standardized tests.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 7787 natural science questions authored for standardized tests, split into a Challenge Set of 2590 questions and an Easy Set of 5197 questions.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The dataset was partitioned into a Challenge Set and an Easy Set; the Challenge Set contains questions answered incorrectly by both a retrieval-based algorithm and a word co-occurrence algorithm.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Questions were collected from multiple sources, restricted to natural science questions, and filtered to non-diagram, multiple-choice questions; the Challenge Set was defined by excluding questions correctly answered by two baseline solvers.
